answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the application of SUDOLM on two distinct scenarios... the model only responds to medical-related queries after verifying the user's credentials.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers or refusals to user queries

answer_2.quote: For the evaluation of control effectiveness in knowledge access control, we use the following three metrics: accuracy, precision, and recall... We also employ MMLU, MT-Bench, and ARC-Challenge to evaluate general utility of SUDOLM.

answer_3.quote: For MT-Bench, we use GPT-4 as a judge to evaluate the response quality by assigning a score on a scale of 10 for the answers to open-ended questions.
